findings.issue: Committed build output (app/.next/) ships inside the reviewed directory, including config snapshots that only reflect a past build, not the source of truth
findings.suggestion: Delete app/.next from the repo and add it to .gitignore; rely on app/next.config.mjs as the only config artifact

summary: This is a deliberately conservative app: on the current stable Next.js 16.4.3 and React 19.3.1, it uses nothing but long-stable App Router primitives and skips every headline experimental feature of its own framework version (Cache Components, use cache, proxy.ts). Data caching is hand-rolled in lib/api.js rather than reaching for the still-experimental caching model, which exactly matches the spec's 'request-time fetch, runtime caching OK' constraint. Risk of framework churn breaking this code is minimal; the only hygiene note is that .next/ build artifacts are committed under app/.
